name: guardfall-bash
description: GuardFall classes A-E for bash: adversarial inputs that evade a surface-level scanner. Every case must be classified as 'effect present or top' (no silent misses).

cases.note: empty single-quote fragment inside the command name
double-quote fragment inside the command name
backslash-escaped first letter
word splitting via the default IFS
braced IFS expansion
command substitution yielding the program name
command substitution nested inside an argument
dynamically-named program via a variable
backtick command substitution
encoded payload piped to an interpreter
evaluating a string as code
interpreter invoked with a command string
remote payload piped to an interpreter
unbounded loop: the step budget must yield top
unknown binary: degrades to top
dynamically-named program: degrades to top
C4 adversarial: unbalanced quote; the parse failure must degrade to top, not to a benign miss
C4 adversarial: pipeline of unresolved commands; must degrade to top, not to an empty result
C4 adversarial: deep nesting around an unresolved command; must stay bounded and covered

cases.input: alias a=b; alias a=b; alias a=b; frobnicate
cases.note: C4 adversarial: repeated alias records; the record cap must bound the analysis and the unresolved command must degrade to top
